description: Step 12: Hand it to the owner. Optional hand-over: emails a sign-in link bound to this business to `email` (default: ownerEmail), adding them as owner first. Nothing in setup needs it: the agent can keep running the line, and the human can take over any time by clicking the link (that sets ownerSignedInAt). 5 per business per hour; pass a new idempotencyKey to send again. Identical requests are deduplicated for 24 hours; use a new idempotencyKey only to deliberately repeat the action.

businessId.description: Defaults to the business of the API key in the Authorization header.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Retries of the same call should reuse it (the stored result comes back); a new value deliberately repeats an identical call. The MCP POST's Idempotency-Key header takes precedence.
